Reference / runtime/utf

runtime/utf#

The native layer under encoding/utf, http/sse, io/stdin, json: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under encoding/utf, http/sse, io/stdin, json: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable UTF codec boundary for encoding/utf. Every backend implements the same scalar-value, byte-order and malformed-prefix contract.
